assistant:
At **20:00 on 6 January**, the assessment found two violations: **Bus_29 at 0.943 p.u.** (below 0.95) and **Bus_0–Bus_1 [L0] at 114.7%** loading (above 100%). The optimizer found six dispatch options; **all were confirmed by AC power flow** to clear the violations. They kept the maximum loading at or below 90% and the voltage range within 0.950–1.05 p.u.

| Option | Dispatch approach | MW moved | External-grid import | Cost | Difference from cheapest |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **Cheapest** | Raise active power from Gen_bus1, Gen_bus7 and Gen_bus10; adjust their voltage set-points, plus Gen_bus12’s set-point | 34.36 MW | 147.81 MW | **€26.48/h** | — |
| **Near-optimal 1** | Raise Gen_bus1 and Gen_bus7; adjust voltage set-points. **Avoids active-power changes from Gen_bus10** | 32.29 MW | 150.47 MW | €29.13/h | +€2.65/h (+10.0%) |
| **Near-optimal 2** | Raise Gen_bus1, Gen_bus7, Gen_bus10 and Gen_bus12; adjust set-points | 33.90 MW | 148.44 MW | €29.13/h | +€2.65/h (+10.0%) |
| **Near-optimal 3** | Raise Gen_bus1, Gen_bus7, Gen_bus10 and Gen_bus12; adjust set-points | 33.10 MW | 149.46 MW | €29.13/h | +€2.65/h (+10.0%) |
| **Near-optimal 4** | Raise Gen_bus1, Gen_bus7, Gen_bus10 and Gen_bus12; adjust set-points | 35.12 MW | 146.90 MW | €29.13/h | +€2.65/h (+10.0%) |
| **Near-optimal 5** | Raise Gen_bus1, Gen_bus7 and Gen_bus10; adjust voltage set-points, with a different balance of dispatch | 34.87 MW | 147.36 MW | €29.12/h | +€2.64/h (+10.0%) |

For the **cheapest** option, Gen_bus1 rises by 7.96 MW, Gen_bus7 by 14.88 MW, and Gen_bus10 by 11.52 MW; external-grid import falls by 37.54 MW. The cost figures use a mix of case-file and synthetic prices. The optimizer’s lower bound means no qualifying dispatch costs less than **€22.48/h**, but the gap is large enough that the cheapest found option is **not certified as the best possible**. These are alternatives for the operator to weigh; I haven’t selected one.

📋 Data source: measurements

Holding **Gen_bus1 at its scheduled active output of 45.99 MW**, the optimizer found six options that clear both violations at 20:00 on 6 January. **All six passed the AC power-flow check**: voltages are within 0.950–1.05 p.u. and maximum line loading is at or below 90%.

| Option | Other units’ active-power changes | MW moved | Import | Cost |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Cheapest** | Gen_bus4 +1.51 MW; Gen_bus7 +14.88 MW; Gen_bus10 +12.75 MW; Gen_bus12 +17.00 MW | 46.15 | 135.34 MW | **€127.07/h** |
| Near-optimal 1 | Gen_bus4 +9.00 MW; Gen_bus7 +14.88 MW; Gen_bus10 +12.75 MW; Gen_bus12 +7.76 MW | 44.39 | 136.82 MW | €139.77/h |
| Near-optimal 2 | Gen_bus4 +5.60 MW; Gen_bus7 +14.88 MW; Gen_bus10 +7.96 MW; Gen_bus12 +17.00 MW | 45.45 | 135.97 MW | €139.77/h |
| Near-optimal 3 | Gen_bus4 +4.63 MW; Gen_bus7 +11.28 MW; Gen_bus10 +12.75 MW; Gen_bus12 +17.00 MW | 45.66 | 135.77 MW | €139.77/h |
| Near-optimal 4 | Gen_bus4 +5.03 MW; Gen_bus7 +12.84 MW; Gen_bus10 +10.69 MW; Gen_bus12 +17.00 MW | 45.57 | 135.85 MW | €139.77/h |
| Near-optimal 5 | Gen_bus4 +4.36 MW; Gen_bus7 +14.88 MW; Gen_bus10 +12.75 MW; Gen_bus12 +15.85 MW | 47.84 | **133.40 MW** | €139.77/h |

**Important:** Gen_bus1 was held at its active-power schedule, but it remains in service and voltage-controlled; its reactive output changes in the solutions. If you mean you want it fully out of service, say so—the dispatch would need to be re-optimized with a generator outage instead. The costs use a mix of case-file and synthetic prices. The cheapest found option is not certified as globally cheapest; the solver’s lower bound is €77.89/h.
